clips.name: Idle
clips.description: Gentle breathing, a small head sway and ear flick.

clips.name: Headpat
clips.description: Three soft head dips, a pleased tilt and relaxed ears, returning to rest.

clips.name: Happy
clips.description: Raised paws, perked ears and two small cheerful hops, returning to rest.

clips.name: Wave
clips.description: Raises one paw, waves three times, then lowers it with an ear perk.

clips.name: Walk
clips.description: Alternating little steps and opposite paw swings; stays in place for future steering.

clips.name: Curious
clips.description: Pauses to listen, tilts its head, and perks one ear before returning to rest.

clips.name: Petting
clips.description: Leans into a pet, relaxes its ears, and gently sways with its paws tucked in.

clips.name: Nuzzle
clips.description: Reaches both paws forward and leans its cheek toward a hand, then settles back.

clips.name: Startled
clips.description: A quick flinch with raised paws and perked ears, followed by a slower recovery.

clips.name: Drowsy
clips.description: Sleepy breathing, a bowed head, drooped ear tips, and a slow head bob.

clips.name: Idle
clips.description: Soft head movement while waiting.

clips.name: Tail wag
clips.description: A relaxed standing tail wag.

clips.name: Walk
clips.description: A slow four-beat walk in place.

clips.name: Trot
clips.description: A brisk diagonal gait with a lively tail; stays in place for future approach movement.

clips.name: Headpat
clips.description: Three soft head dips and a pleased tilt with a tail wag, returning to rest.

clips.name: Scratch
clips.description: Leans into a scratch with a tipped head and an eager tail wag.

clips.name: Happy
clips.description: An excited whole-body wiggle with a lifted head and a fast wag.

clips.name: Curious
clips.description: Looks to one side and tilts its head as if listening, then straightens up.

clips.name: Play bow
clips.description: Lowers its chest with its hindquarters raised and tail wagging, inviting play.

clips.name: Sniff
clips.description: Lowers its nose and makes small searching movements near the ground.

clips.name: Shake
clips.description: Shakes its head and shoulders in a quick ripple, then settles its tail.

clips.name: Offer paw
clips.description: Lifts one front paw to offer a friendly shake, then places it back on the floor.
